title: A Card Should Answer the Question Being Asked
description: บันทึกการตัดสินใจเรื่องการ์ดแอปบนหน้าแรก หลังเจอว่ามันไม่ตอบคำถามที่คนกำลังถามอยู่ คนที่เลื่อนดูรายการแอปถามอยู่สี่ข้อ — นี่คืออะไร ใช้ได้เลยไหม เท่าไร กดอะไรต่อ — การ์ดปัจจุบันตอบสองข้อครึ่ง และซ่อนราคาไว้อีกหน้าหนึ่ง เวอร์ชันนี้ยังบันทึกบั๊ก gap ที่หายไปซึ่งซ่อนตัวมาตลอดจนกระทั่งหมวดหนึ่งมีการ์ดสองใบ และเหตุผลที่เราจะไม่ลอกเปอร์เซ็นต์ความคืบหน้าของคู่แข่ง แต่จะใช้วันที่จริงแทน
scope: state the four questions a catalogue card must answer, and stop it answering fewer
put the price on the card, because sending someone to another page to learn it is not simplicity
use the app's own purpose line on the card instead of the three-word browsing blurb
restore the missing gap between cards in a category, which read as one box with a hairline
align the card's right edge into one column: status, price, action, top to bottom
replace a competitor's development-progress percentage with a real date from the registry
defer search and filtering until the catalogue is large enough to need it, and say what large enough means
verification: อ่านค่า grid จริงจาก globals.css: การ์ดแนวนอนเป็น 104px | 1fr | 180px และคอลัมน์กลางกว้าง 790px ในคอนเทนเนอร์ 1160px
.market-category__apps ไม่มี gap เลย ต่างจาก .app-grid (16px) และ .market-category-stack (18px) ในไฟล์เดียวกัน
ยืนยันว่า announced_at มีอยู่จริงในตาราง apps แล้ว จาก migration 0006 ของ IP-090
NOT STARTED: ยังไม่มีการแก้โค้ดใด ๆ ในเวอร์ชันนี้ เป็นการบันทึกการตัดสินใจล้วน
rollback: เอกสารล้วน ย้อนได้โดยไม่กระทบโค้ด
constraints: An announcement is a statement, never a grant. What a member may actually use is decided by app_entitlements and nothing else.
The registry is the single switchboard. A second flag mechanism for the same app would be two switches on one lamp.
Revoking an announcement clears announced_at and never deletes the row, because app_entitlements.app_id cascades.
This version ships unseen. The next session verifies it in a browser before anything is called released.

items.title: Verify the announced app registry in a browser end to end, since v0.34.0 shipped without a single screen ever being looked at
Scope member_free to the apps an administrator has announced, moving the list out of platform.ts into the apps registry
Route the landing page and /market app labels through the registry too, so a seeded default stops being a public claim anywhere
Issue a member_free entitlement when a member enters an app the registry announces as free, so an announcement can become an open app
Prove by source scan that the back office reads no column of a closed table, and that the scanner itself can fail
Build the pricing and promotion editors behind the administrator check, writing an audit event per change
Open payment collection: choose a provider, tie a settled invoice to an entitlement state, and write the ADR that governs it
Move the access tier copy out of source and into content the back-office owns
Decide whether trial entitlements issued under the five-day term are migrated to seven days
Show in the estimate where a Factor F came from: printed step or interpolation, and the two steps it sits between
Give the product a way to tell that the Factor F and labour circulars it holds are still the current ones
Bring the ว480 labour rate schedule in as a dataset, keeping the conditions that change a rate (quantity bands, area, method) as data rather than notes
Have a qualified person certify the Factor F dataset and record the name, so pricing can require a reviewed table
Record ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ and ประมาณราคาโดย on the estimate so the sheet header can be filled
Retire takeoff_items.category once headings carry the same meaning
Require a human verification step before any OCR-extracted price or factor can be used in a calculation
Enforce capabilities.read on every ESTIMETR read path so the platform kill switch stops reads, not only writes
Order organization selection deterministically before a member can belong to more than one organization
Validate the official source for ปร.4, ปร.5 and ปร.6 against the Comptroller General's Department, which ว499 and ว481 confirm is the issuing authority
Apply GitHub branch protection once the plan upgrade allows it
Give roadmap item ids a single owner: IP-059 was issued twice, in v0.18.0 and again in v0.20.0, for unrelated work
Give the site header an account menu that names the viewer and offers a way out
Let a member read their own entitlements, organizations and open sessions at /account
Add accounts.issuer so better-auth 1.7 can identify an account and Google sign-in completes
Give every app a Thai program name and a one-line purpose in one fixed position
Register the ค่า K app as coming_soon so it is named before it is routed

Let a member edit their own profile: real name, uploaded photo, contact details and an explicit, recorded consent to receive news — PDPA makes the consent record part of the feature, not a checkbox beside it
Publish the platform's own channels (LINE OA, Facebook page, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube) from one place, so a channel is added without editing pages
Replace the placeholder badge the ค่า K app borrowed from the platform mark
Refresh the provider avatar and name on every sign-in, not only on the first one, so a changed Google photo is not stale forever
Decide whether an expired or trial member may print a read-only PDF — today ADR 0003 locks export and print for the whole trial, which is deliberate and needs a superseding ADR to change

Publish a privacy and cookie disclosure page and link it from the footer — the site sets only strictly necessary cookies today, which need disclosing rather than consenting, and there is no such page at all

Build consent as a mechanism that actually withholds a script until it is granted, not a banner that hides itself — required before the first LINE, Facebook, TikTok, Instagram or YouTube embed, never after

ADR: how consent is recorded — against a user or a device, since someone not signed in must be able to consent; which policy version it was given against; and when a policy change must ask again. Covers both cookie consent and the news consent in IP-105, because they are one question asked twice

Finish the two back-office tests displaced by the UI work: post to changeEntitlement with no cookie, and revoke the administrator grant from the account holding it, confirming the break-glass script becomes runnable again
Look at /account and press the sign-out-other-devices button — the page has only ever been checked for a 200, and the button has never been pressed
Make the catalogue card answer all four questions a visitor is actually asking — what it is, whether it is open, what it costs, what to press — and put the price on the card rather than a page away
Restore the missing gap in .market-category__apps: two cards in one category currently touch, reading as a single box divided by a hairline. Hidden until a category held more than one app

Show a real 'last updated' date from apps.announced_at on an unreleased app instead of a development-progress percentage — the percentage proves nothing, has to be invented weekly, and stalls at 90%; a stale date indicts us honestly
Add search and category filtering to the app list once the catalogue reaches roughly ten apps — at five, four categories on one scrollable page is already the simpler answer
ADR: what a catalogue card may claim. Records why a progress percentage is refused where a date is accepted, so the question is answered once rather than re-argued each time a competitor ships one
